overview: Players tell the admins what went wrong, or what could be better, without leaving the game.

1.0.1: No change to play: a fresh number so the build had a file of its own to go up.
1.0.0: /bug and /idea take a line from any player; /issues reads the latest back to an op.
Each report keeps the time, who sent it, where they stood and the block they looked at.
One line at a time to a file any editor can read. Stock clients can report.
